Version: Fortinet FortiOS 6.0.0 to 6.0.4, 5.6.3 to 5.6.7 and 5.4.6 to 5.4.12
Method of Attack: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (Path Traversal) allowing unauthenticated attacker to download system files via specially crafted HTTP resource requests
Attack Vector: Exploitation of public-facing VPN web portals and services
Indicators of Compromise: Leaked credentials for nearly 50,000 Fortinet VPN devices on hacker forum
Targeting of U.S. government networks, COVID-19 research organizations
